title: Taskboard Integration Progress Report
summary: Aggregator service created to read existing Kafka topics and expose a read-only task feed. The widget server will attempt to proxy to this service; fallback to local /tmp persistence remains available.
report: Files created: task_aggregator.py, task_api.py, ARCHITECTURE.md, example_output.json. API endpoints: GET /tasks, GET /task/{taskId}. The aggregator consumes ai.dev.approval.required, ai.dev.review.out, ai.dev.task.ofbiz, ai.dev.result.out and synthesizes a small read model. Run: pip install confluent-kafka flask; python3 task_api.py; then restart widget server and open Element widget.
